fusions.name: Run-Up
fusions.desc: You land on the target for 30 damage that ignores its armour, and leave it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Kicked-Up Mud
fusions.desc: Kicks a spray of mud 3 tiles ahead of you, dealing 7 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance per hit to leave it [Hindered] for 3 seconds, its attacks slowed. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Drumming Pulse
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Springing Gait
fusions.desc: You move 12% faster, and your water resistance rises by 10%.
